en: A black-and-white photograph showing a well-manicured public park with curved pathways and a circular fountain area in the foreground. In the center background is a prominent, ornate building with a clock tower and the word 'Rathhaus' (German for 'town hall') visible above the entrance. The area is surrounded by elegant residential buildings and tree-lined streets. In the distance, hilly terrain with vineyards and a few hilltop structures are visible.
